diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in the default/baseline values (e.g., 12 baseline workers, 80% scale-out trigger, $18,000 cap) which correspond to the initial state before any private facts are applied. Since no checks passed, there is no evidence of a leak, but the model consistently defaulted to the public starting values without being forced to resolve the conflicts introduced by PF1, PF2, or PF3.
